roads.name: Hardscrabble Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 31 in 2.1 miles, about 15 a mile.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 137 to 374 ft, with 725 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.64 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Forest City Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 6 curves in 2.5 miles.
From 434 to 643 ft, with 385 ft of up and down along the way.
